A three men panel, that have been associated with a nearby university had over 100 years of experiences among them and their age totaled over 200 years.

Chosen from a group of men that represent lawyers, doctors and professors among others.

First question,

What were experiences in your life that confirmed that God knew you personally and individually?

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A three-man panel—each long associated with a nearby university—sat together with more than a century of combined professional experience and over two hundred years of life between them.

The first question posed to them was simple, but profound:

> **“What experiences in your life have confirmed that God knows you personally and individually?”**

> **"Share an experience when you realized that relying on your own strength was not enough. What changed when you turned to Christ?"**

> **"What role has prayer played in your discipleship? How has it deepened your relationship with God and Jesus Christ?"**

------------------------------------------------------------------------

This group is led by person whose PhD dissertation was, DIVINE BENEVOLENCE, EMBODIMENT, AND SALVATION IN THE TEACHINGS OF JOSEPH SMITH AND THE BOOK OF MORMON
